gloss: to cover, to hide, to conceal

definitions.explanation: To put something over or upon.

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}が{山|やま}を{覆|おお}っている。
{顔|かお}を{手|て}で{覆|おお}った。
examples.english: I covered my face with my hands.

examples.japanese: {雲|くも}が{空|そら}を{覆|おお}う。

notes:
{覆|おお}う means to cover.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{覆|おお}う: to cover ~
- 〜に{覆|おお}われる: to be covered by ~

RELATED:
- {覆|おお}い: cover (noun)
- {覆|くつがえ}す: to overturn (different reading)
